newsitem.title: UK: New logistics capability from TNT Worldwide.
newsitem.headline: New logistics capability from TNT Worldwide.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide said it and TNT Logistics will offer multi-national companies a coordinated global one-stop, integrated logistics capability.
The company said in a statement that the service will be coordinated by a new "Value Added Solutions" department, which started operations this month, it added.
Customers seeking pan-regional solutions in Europe or Asia Pacific will have access to both companies'experience in providing local and regional logistics and transport solutions.

In addition, customers benefit from a simpler more streamlined service and one point of contact for all coordination. This new capability also means that for the first time there is the real possibility of creating a tailored solution covering a number of countries.
TNT Multi Country Logistics product director, Ian Speak said the new operation" is designed to respond by leveraging the expertise and strong international infrastructure of both organisations."

"Not only are we able to handle the international physical distribution necessary, but we are also able to combine this with warehousing, production planning, supply chain management and other solutions," he added.
TNT is part of the Dutch part office group, Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV. -- Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
